sourceText: “I thought it was madness,” he said, as he replaced the obnoxious paper in the safe, “and now I begin to fear it is disgrace.”

attempts.label: primary

TRANSLATION: “mi pilin e ni: ni li nasa,” ona li toki. ona li pana sin e lipu ike ni lon poki awen, li toki e ni: “taso tenpo ni la mi open monsuta tan pilin ni: ken la ni li weka e nimi pona.”
NOTES: NONE
